assets.description: The case that takes a new client from a positive intro call to an active administration: the chosen plan by legal form (eenmanszaak or Starters €840, VOF €1,140 for two partners plus €100 per extra partner, holding BV €1,750, werkmaatschappij €2,450 per year ex VAT), the signed subscription agreement and processing agreement with the first full fiscal year commitment, identification of the entrepreneur and partners for the client account, KVK and VAT number verification, the questionnaire on bank accounts, employees, previous bookkeeper and open filings, bookkeeper matching based on sector and office, account access and app installation, the first-upload coaching call, the add-ons activated and the checklist status until the first bookkeeper review. Managed by Onboarding, Fit Check and Bookkeeper Matching (onbd) and extended by Switch Service and Historical Data Import (swch) when a previous bookkeeper is involved.
assets.businessMeaning: Where the first-year commitment and the personal relationship are set up: time to bookkeeper assignment and onboarding completion time predict whether a client is still there after the first fiscal year.
assets.accessScope: client success executives; the matched bookkeeper once assigned; the client for their own checklist; identification details captured here written directly to the client account and masked in the case afterwards

interfaces.name: onboarding-case api
interfaces.description: Case creation from a lead, plan selection, agreement e-signing, identification and KVK verification, questionnaire, matching request, account provisioning, add-on activation, checklist and completion API used by the sales and client success workspace, the client app, workload planning, subscription billing and the switch service.

interfaces.name: onboarding events
interfaces.description: Case opened, agreement signed, account provisioned, bookkeeper matched, first upload coached, switch import requested and onboarding completed events consumed by identity, workload planning, subscription billing, notifications, the switch service and conversion dashboards.

interfaces.name: onboarding documents
interfaces.description: Signed subscription and processing agreements as PDF, the onboarding questionnaire export for the bookkeeper and the welcome package sent to the client.

governance.retention: signed agreements kept for the life of the subscription and 7 years after termination as the contractual basis; case details and questionnaire reduced to the client account and bookkeeper notes 12 months after completion; identification copies not retained once verified
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to client success and the matched bookkeeper; agreements shared with the client; never shared with partners beyond the referral confirmation the client consented to

assets.name: Historical Return Import
assets.description: The digital copies a switching client provides from their previous bookkeeper or their own records: prior-year income tax returns and assessments, VAT returns of the current year already filed, the last annual accounts and balance sheet, the fixed-asset and depreciation register, open debtors and creditors, the previous ledger export where available, the DigiD or intermediary authorisation transfer and the questions to the previous bookkeeper; with the import status per document, the opening balances derived and posted to the ledger, the gaps found (missing quarters, unfiled returns) and the bookkeeper's sign-off that the history is complete. Managed by Switch Service and Historical Data Import (swch) inside the onboarding case and the source of opening balances and prior-year comparisons for the year-end close and income tax return.
assets.businessMeaning: What makes switching to Kees painless: a complete history means no gap in VAT or income tax filings, no double work in the first year-end and a bookkeeper who knows the client's past from day one.
assets.accessScope: the client; the client success executive handling the switch; the matched bookkeeper and backup; previous-bookkeeper correspondence visible to client success only; BSN on imported returns masked outside the filing modules

interfaces.name: historical-import api
interfaces.description: Document checklist per legal form, secure upload and previous-bookkeeper request tracking, opening-balance derivation and posting, gap detection, sign-off and archive hand-over API used by the switch service, the onboarding case, the ledger, the year-end close and income tax preparation.

interfaces.name: import events
interfaces.description: Documents requested, document received, opening balances posted, gap detected, history signed off and import archived events consumed by the onboarding case, the review queue, deadline orchestration and notifications.

interfaces.name: imported history
interfaces.description: PDF, XAF auditfile, CSV and Excel files received from the client or the previous bookkeeper and staged for import, and the opening-balance sheet exported into the client's first annual accounts.

governance.retention: staged files deleted 90 days after sign-off once archived in the client's document archive, where they follow the 7-year fiscal retention of the administration they belong to; requests to previous bookkeepers kept 2 years
governance.sharingPolicy: received from the client or, with the client's authorisation, from the previous bookkeeper; internal to the client's bookkeeper and client success; never shared with partners

assets.name: Subscription Plan
assets.description: The catalogue of what Kees de Boekhouder and Founders sell and the plan attached to each client: the fixed yearly plans per legal form (eenmanszaak and Starters €840, VOF €1,140 for two partners plus €100 per extra partner, holding BV €1,750, werkmaatschappij €2,450, all ex VAT per year invoiced monthly), the add-ons (bank connection €5 per month per connected account, partner income tax return €125 incl. VAT, payroll €17.50 per payslip per employee per month), what each plan includes (bookkeeper review, quarterly VAT return, annual accounts, income tax return, questions all year), the first full fiscal year commitment and the monthly cancellation with one calendar month notice afterwards, partner discounts, price versions with effective dates and the client's current plan with its history. Managed by Subscription Plans, Billing and Cancellation (subs).
assets.businessMeaning: The fixed, transparent price is the promise the brand must keep at scale: the plan catalogue is where that promise is encoded, and plan history is what explains every subscription invoice.
assets.accessScope: the client for their own plan and terms; client success and billing for changes; the growth team for the catalogue; the catalogue itself is public on the website

interfaces.name: subscription-plan api
interfaces.description: Plan catalogue and price versions, plan assignment per client, add-on activation and deactivation, partner discount application, commitment and notice-period evaluation, plan change on legal-form change and cancellation API used by onboarding, the client app, subscription billing, the bank connection and payroll modules and the partner programme.

interfaces.name: subscription events
interfaces.description: Plan assigned, add-on activated, price version published, plan changed, cancellation notice received and subscription ended events consumed by subscription billing, bank connection, payroll, workload planning, notifications and churn dashboards.

governance.retention: a client's plan history kept for the life of the subscription and 7 years after termination as the basis of the invoices; catalogue versions kept indefinitely
governance.sharingPolicy: catalogue public on the website; a client's plan visible to the client, their bookkeeper and billing; never shared with partners beyond the discount confirmation

assets.name: Subscription Invoice
assets.description: The monthly invoice from Kees de Boekhouder or Founders to a client: the monthly instalment of the yearly fixed fee for the plan, add-on lines for the number of connected bank accounts at €5 each, payslips processed at €17.50 each and a partner income tax return at €125 incl. VAT when ordered, partner discounts, VAT on the fee, the period, the SEPA direct debit mandate and collection date, payment status, dunning steps, credit notes for plan changes, the cancellation settlement at the end of the first fiscal year or after the notice period, and the link to the client's own administration where the fee itself is booked as a cost. Issued by Subscription Plans, Billing and Cancellation (subs) and collected through the payment provider connected via the Integration and API Gateway.
assets.businessMeaning: The company's own revenue record and the moment the fixed price becomes visible to the client every month; add-on lines are also the usage signal for bank connections and payroll.
assets.accessScope: the client for their own invoices; billing and client success; the finance team of Kees for revenue and collection; the client's bookkeeper sees the invoice only as a cost booking in the administration

interfaces.name: subscription-invoice api
interfaces.description: Monthly invoice run, add-on usage aggregation, discount and credit note handling, SEPA mandate and collection, payment status, dunning, cancellation settlement and revenue reporting API used by subscription billing, the client app, the payment provider integration and finance reporting.

interfaces.name: billing events
interfaces.description: Invoice issued, direct debit collected, collection failed, dunning step reached, credit note issued and settlement completed events consumed by notifications, client success, the client's own administration booking and revenue dashboards.

interfaces.name: subscription invoice outputs
interfaces.description: PDF invoices and credit notes for the client, SEPA direct debit batches for the payment provider and monthly revenue exports for the company's own bookkeeping.

governance.retention: kept 7 years after the end of the fiscal year as the company's own fiscal administration under the fiscal retention duty; mandates kept 14 months after the last collection as required by the SEPA scheme
governance.sharingPolicy: sent to the client; collection data shared with the payment provider as processor; the company's own accountant and the Belastingdienst receive aggregated revenue; never shared with partners

stores.name: Client Account DB
stores.description: Relational schema (PostgreSQL-style, row-level client keys) for client accounts, legal entities, trading names, VOF partners and shareholders, assigned bookkeepers and backups, add-on flags and cancellation status; BSN and date of birth stored in encrypted columns readable only by the filing modules.

stores.name: Identity DB
stores.description: Identity and access schema for user logins of clients, partners, bookkeepers and staff: credential hashes, two-factor secrets, roles and portfolio scopes, sessions, device and push registrations and consent records; separated from client data so authentication can be hardened and rotated independently.

stores.name: Audit Log Store
stores.description: Write-once, hash-chained log of every privileged read, change, export, filing release and external call across the platform, with retention tiers per entry type; the source for AVG access reports and fiscal reconstruction.

stores.name: Bookkeeping Ledger DB
stores.description: The general ledger schema per entity and fiscal year: ledger accounts and schemes per legal form, journal entries, expense bookings, transaction matches, period locks, VOF partner allocations, depreciation schedules and the published rule values from the knowledge base; the system of record for the administration Kees carries fiscal responsibility for.

stores.name: Tax Filings DB
stores.description: Schema for prepared and filed returns and their lifecycle: VAT returns with box values and reconciliation, annual accounts data, income tax returns, corporate tax returns, filing submissions with acknowledgements and assessments, and the deadlines they were filed against; locked per version once released.

stores.name: Client Document Archive
stores.description: Encrypted object storage organised per entity and fiscal year for receipt originals, invoice and quote PDFs, annual accounts, filed return copies, payslips, signed agreements and imported history; versioned, immutable once a period is locked, with retention labels driving 7-year and 10-year deletion.

stores.name: Recognition Results Store
stores.description: Document store for Scan & Herken output: extracted fields with confidence per receipt, duplicate fingerprints, category suggestions, client corrections and the feedback used to tune recognition; keyed to the receipt document and pseudonymised for model evaluation.

stores.name: Bank Transaction DB
stores.description: Schema for bank connections and the transaction feed synchronised through Ponto four times a day: accounts, consent metadata and expiry, raw transactions with Ponto identifiers for idempotent ingestion, private flags, match state and statement imports for periods without a connection.

stores.name: Ponto Consent Vault
stores.description: Key management service holding the PSD2 access and refresh tokens per Ponto integration, the Ponto client credentials and the certificates and authorisations used for Belastingdienst and KVK channels; secrets readable only by the sync and filing services, rotated and revoked on consent expiry.

stores.name: Invoicing DB
stores.description: Schema for quotes, invoices and credit notes per trading name with sequential numbering, line items and VAT treatment, customer contacts of clients, delivery tracking, payment status and reminder history; the sales side of every administration.

stores.name: Payroll DB
stores.description: Segregated schema for employees and DGAs of clients: contracts, wage data, monthly payroll runs, payslips, wage tax return data and annual statements, with BSN and identity document references in encrypted columns and its own 5-year and 7-year retention rules.

stores.name: Authority Filing Mirror
stores.description: Mirror of the message exchange with the Belastingdienst and KVK digital channels: outbound submissions, transport acknowledgements, processing responses, rejection reports, assessments and KVK extracts and deposit confirmations, kept as received for proof of filing.

stores.name: Bookkeeper Workspace DB
stores.description: Schema for the bookkeeper workspace across the three offices: filing calendars and deadlines, review tasks with time tracking, client allocations and capacity plans, QA samples and findings, and per-bookkeeper productivity and first-time-right measures.

stores.name: Client Communication Store
stores.description: Document store for message threads, e-mail correspondence, call logs, meeting records and attachments between clients and their bookkeepers, with response-time metadata and links to the client file objects and knowledge articles referenced.

stores.name: Knowledge Base CMS
stores.description: Content store for the advice knowledge base: tax rule articles with per-tax-year values, bookkeeper answer templates, client-facing explanations, review workflow and version history; contains no client data.

stores.name: Knowledge Search Index
stores.description: Search index over knowledge articles, suggested answers, client messages, receipt text, customer contacts and network profiles, scoped per client account and per role so a bookkeeper searches only their portfolio and a client only their own administration.

stores.name: CRM and Growth DB
stores.description: Schema for leads and intro calls, onboarding cases, partner agreements and referral claims, network profiles and client stories with consent records and channel attribution; kept apart from the administration so marketing data never enters a client file uninvited.

stores.name: Subscription Billing DB
stores.description: Schema for the plan catalogue and price versions, each client's plan and add-on history, monthly subscription invoices, SEPA mandates and collections, dunning and cancellation settlements; the company's own revenue administration.

stores.name: Import Staging Zone
stores.description: Encrypted staging area for files received from switching clients and previous bookkeepers (PDF returns, XAF auditfiles, CSV and Excel ledgers, bank statements) and for bulk exports handed over to a client leaving; files deleted on a 90-day schedule after archiving.

stores.name: Dashboard and Notification Store
stores.description: Low-latency document store for the materialised dashboard snapshots per entity, VAT position views, to-do lists and the notification queue with delivery and read state, rebuilt from the ledger and event stream at any time.

stores.name: Operations Analytics Warehouse
stores.description: Pseudonymised analytical warehouse for bookkeeper productivity (clients served, review turnaround, first-time-right), recognition and match rates, on-time filing, conversion and churn, add-on usage and revenue; the source of team metrics and KPI pyramids, never of client-facing figures.

stores.name: Domain Event Bus
stores.description: Message bus carrying the domain events of every asset (booking posted, transaction synced, return filed, task completed, plan changed) between modules, the audit trail, notifications and the warehouse, with per-topic retention and client-scoped payloads.
